subject: DELETE statement
notes: || UPHELD with independent evidence. GR21 b) --check OK ('The ON EXCEPTION phrase is ignored, if it is specified.'). Code READ myself: EmitDeleteFile emits SeqIo.EmitStoreFileStatus(df.File) immediately after the FileDeleteFile/FileDeleteFileRetry call (GR21 a); FileRegistry.DeleteFile returns FileStatusCode.Success on an actual File.Delete and FileStatusCode.OptionalFileNotFound for '!File.Exists(c.HostPath)' -- both successful values (GR14). GR21 b): the two-phrase arm emits 'if (__kstN[0] != '0') { <ON> } else { <NOT ON> }', so on any '0x' the NOT ON EXCEPTION block runs and the ON EXCEPTION block is skipped, which is literally 'the ON EXCEPTION phrase is ignored'; the NOT-ON-alone arm emits 'if (__kstN[0] == '0') { <NOT ON> }'. Control falls out of the emitted block, satisfying 'control is then transferred to the end of the DELETE statement'.
